messages.text: My Bitfortun BS-1 stopped working and I need to return it for a warranty exchange
I'll check our records and the triage rules first.

Hi, I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Sarah passed this over to me so I can work out what the unit is doing before anything is decided.

Two quick things first:

1. Just so we are on the same page: our BitFortun line is the BS-2 / BS-4. If yours is a BS-1, tell me what the label on the bottom says exactly, and I'll work from that.
2. One thing I say early on every warranty check, no surprises later: a unit run above the hashrate it is sold at counts as overclocking and is not covered. So let me know what mode or hashrate it has been running at.

Now the fault itself. "Stopped working" can mean several very different things, so let's start at the plug:

1. Plug it in and tell me what happens. Does the screen light up at all, do the fans spin, is there any LED on the board?

That one answer tells me whether we are looking at a power supply, a firmware issue or the board itself.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

Thanks, that photo tells me a lot. Here is what I see on it:

- BitFortun BS-1, LILYGO screen lit, green LEDs on the board, so the 5V/logic side is alive
- 0 GH/s hashrate
- ASIC 54C, VR 44C
- PWR 0W and BD -- (no board reporting)
- It is on your network at 192.168.1.220

So the controller boots and talks to the network, but the mining chip is drawing zero watts and nothing is reporting a board. That is either firmware not bringing the ASIC up, or the 12V side / voltage regulator not feeding it.

One step at a time, and this is the one I need next:

1. On a phone or computer on the same network, open http://192.168.1.220 in a browser.
2. Tell me the firmware version it shows, and what the ASIC or chip line reads (for example "0 chips detected", or an error / VREG message in the status or logs).

A screenshot of that page is perfect if it is easier than typing it out.

Also, still open from my last message: has it ever been run above its rated hashrate (overclocked), and which of your two orders did this unit come on?
